signed_zero_caveat.claim: fma_array's reconstruction may return +0.0 where math.fma returns -0.0, when the product a*b is an exact zero -- the closing two-sum add loses the zero's sign.
signed_zero_caveat.class: Pre-existing (surfaced by the lane march), numerically inert, in-domain, unreachable on the march.
signed_zero_caveat.why_not_fenced: Zeros are deliberately exempt from FMA_ARRAY_MIN_ABS because 0*x is exactly 0 and cannot underflow; fencing them would refuse legal calls to suppress a sign bit.
signed_zero_caveat.why_unreachable: scripts/r3fma_domain_probe.py counts ZERO exact zeros in the MULTIPLIED operand streams a and b over the corpus plus randomized lane batteries, so no reachable call forms an exact-zero product. (588 exact zeros appear in the ADDEND c, which is not multiplied and cannot produce the corner.)
signed_zero_caveat.status: THE LAST KNOWN fma_array <-> math.fma gap. Disclosed in the fma_array docstring by this member; the arithmetic is untouched.
signed_zero_caveat.source: campaign log 2026-08-27gw (all 664 probe failures were exact-zero products).
